title: release-qualify links on Windows MSVC
goal: release-qualify links susi_windows_runtime (extern crate) but was missing from xtask/build.rs configure_for, so it linked the default msvcrt.lib and failed with LNK2005 atexit / LNK1169 on x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, making Windows release qualification impossible. Add it to the OS-UCRT list and add a guard test that every xtask binary linking the runtime is listed.
acceptance: cargo build --offline --locked -p xtask --bin release-qualify succeeds on x86_64-pc-windows-msvc (failed with LNK2005/LNK1169 before)
cargo test -p xtask --test windows_runtime_bin_list passes and fails if a runtime-linking binary is removed from build.rs
results: release-qualify builds on native x86_64-pc-windows-msvc (Rust 1.99.0; LNK1169 before); windows_runtime_bin_list 2 passed; fmt and clippy -p xtask --all-targets -D warnings clean.
limitations: Verified on Windows only; the guard test is portable and also runs on Linux.
